description: This file defines the interface TaxClassService, which extends a generic service interface to provide methods related to TaxClass entities, such as listing by store and retrieving by code.

classes.name: TaxClassService
classes.description: An interface defining service methods for managing TaxClass entities within the system, including retrieval by store and code.

methods.name: listByStore
methods.description: Returns a list of TaxClass objects associated with a specific MerchantStore, may throw ServiceException.

methods.name: getByCode
methods.description: Retrieves a TaxClass by its unique code.

methods.name: getByCode
methods.description: Retrieves a TaxClass by its code and associated MerchantStore.
